div.div: 8 افتلذ مِنْهُ قِطْعَةً مِنَ المَالِ He cut off, or took, for himself, from him, a part, or portion, of the property. (T.) And اِفْتَلَذْتُ مِنْهُ حَقِّى I cut off, or took, for myself, from him, my right, or due. (A, TA.) And افْتَلَذْتُهُ المَالَ I took from him a part, or portion, of the property. (S, O, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
